Off Calendar Aug-03-2005 Judgment Entered
MINI MINUTES: This matter came regularly on calendar this day, by assignment from the Department of the Presiding Judge for Prov-Up Hearing.
Judge Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Ron Sinclair.
Kevin Lee, Esq. for Plaintiff: Fee Hong Wong, present with Mandarin Interperter: Tina Wang.
Plaintiff and Interpreter were sworn and direct examined.
No appearance by the Defendant: Linda Martines.
Co-Defendant: Ronnie Martinez, not present, Defaulted, and Default entered 6-29-05.
After hearing the evidence presented, the Court rules in favor of the Plaintiff and against the Defendant as follows:
Restitution and possession of the premises located at 415 Holloway St., Lower Unit, San Francisco.
Back Rent and Damages of $3600
Counsel to prepare Proposed Judgment.

Aug. 3, 2005
Judgment signed by Judge Ollie Marie-Victoire.
